outcome.answer: None of these papers directly address Bekkers equivariant neural fields; the closest are [3], [8], and [9], which focus on multimodal, structure-aware, or evidence-centric retrieval for question answering rather than neural fields. [3] is about long-document multimodal QA, [8] about exhaustive recall-sensitive QA over structured corpora, and [9] about heterogeneous financial filings.
